patterns.note: Sections often feature full-width backgrounds with content constrained to a central column, but the 'OUR WORK' section breaks this with a large, partially obscured text element overlapping a multi-column image grid.

The site employs extremely large, condensed, uppercase sans-serif typography for primary headings, creating a bold, almost aggressive visual statement that often interacts with or overlays background elements.
A high-contrast, energetic palette is used, dominated by a vibrant yellow and stark black, with white text for readability and a deep purple/blue serving as a subtle accent.

The hero section features a dynamic looping video background. While the provided scroll sequence was unhelpful for observing scroll-triggered motion, the detected animation technologies suggest the site employs a custom smooth scroll experience and scroll-triggered reveals for content sections, such as elements fading or sliding into view as they enter the viewport.
The 'OUR WORK' section is distinctive, featuring a massive, partially transparent 'OUR WORK' text overlaying a grid of project images, creating a layered and impactful visual hierarchy.

technique_notes: The hero section uses a full-bleed video background to create an immediate dynamic visual impact, with text overlaid for branding and a call to action.
The site integrates a custom scroll experience using a library like Locomotive Scroll, providing smooth, non-native scrolling behavior across the page.
Animations for section reveals and element transitions are likely orchestrated with GSAP, causing content blocks to appear with subtle fades or slides as the user scrolls down the page.

design_tokens.type_scale: Extremely oversized, condensed, uppercase headings (~6-8x body) create a bold, almost aggressive statement, with body text and labels being much smaller and more legible.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners throughout, with no visible rounding on any elements.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy in hero and major section breaks, becoming more balanced in content grids and lists, maintaining a clear visual separation between elements.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its audacious use of a high-contrast yellow and black palette combined with extremely large, condensed, uppercase typography that often overlaps or interacts with imagery. This creates an energetic, almost street-art inspired aesthetic that is far from a typical corporate or service-based website.
